CritTable.Hit1: Deadly: Adds +2 damage on your turn.
CritTable.Hit2: Crazy Dance: The enemy loses their next combat turn.
CritTable.Hit3: Disarm: The enemy is prevented from firing that weapon.
CritTable.Hit4: Moral Advantage: Grants +1 on Violence Checks until the end of combat.
CritTable.Hit5: Tactical Advantage: Adds +1 Movement on your turn until the end of combat.
CritTable.Hit6: Mark of Vengeance: The enemy flees, but swears future vengeance against the character.
CritTable.Fail1: The attack hits an ally or an innocent bystander.
CritTable.Fail2: The weapon breaks or the strike's damage is negated.
CritTable.Fail3: Open Guard: Enemies gain +1 on checks against the character until the end of combat.
CritTable.Fail4: Pressure: The character suffers a -1 penalty on attacks against enemies until the end of combat.
CritTable.Fail5: Shaken: The character loses their next turn to recover.
CritTable.Fail6: Fall: The character falls prone and must spend two actions of any type to stand up.
CritTable.ExplosiveSafe: Explosive throw failed (Fogo no Céu prevents detonation in hand).
CritTable.ExplosiveMisfire: The explosive may detonate in your hand! Make a Speed Saving Throw.
